quests.title: Online Marketplace
quests.summary: A full-stack marketplace for buying and selling products, with a React and Redux client, a Node.js API, and Firebase.
quests.details: The client uses React and Redux. Node.js serves the API. Firebase stores application data. PayPal handles payment, and receipts are generated as PDFs.

quests.title: FitTrack
quests.summary: FitTrack is an offline-first fitness application built with React Native and Expo, featuring workout generation, exercise demonstrations, local SQLite storage, and downloadable exercise media delivered through Cloudflare Workers and R2.
quests.details: Workouts and the exercise catalog are stored in local SQLite. Exercise media is downloaded on demand, including equipment-based packs, from Cloudflare R2 through a Worker.

quests.title: Listify — Shopping List
quests.summary: Listify is a React Native and Expo shopping-list app for creating, managing, and organizing lists.

quests.title: Audio Recorder
quests.summary: A React Native app for recording and managing voice notes.

quests.title: Weather App
quests.summary: Modern app providing real-time weather information, hourly forecasts, and weekly forecasts.
